I often find it overwhelming to navigate through different conversations and make small talk with strangers. However, there are moments when I appreciate the energy and diversity that large gatherings bring. I enjoy observing people and their interactions, which can be both intriguing and comforting, knowing I'm not the only one feeling a bit out of my element.

On the other hand, spending time with just a few close friends is where I truly feel at ease. In these smaller gatherings, I can open up more, share my thoughts and feelings without fear of judgment. The intimacy and understanding within these friendships allow for deeper connections and more meaningful conversations. I cherish the laughter, support, and the ability to be my authentic self around them.
